brand.name: Algeria Green
brand.description: A digital platform for contributing to tree-planting initiatives across Algeria and tracking their impact.

home.heroSubtitle: A digital platform for contributing to tree-planting initiatives across Algeria and tracking their impact.
home.statsSubtitle: Figures read live from the platform database. Only verified trees are counted.
home.howSubtitle: Five steps, from discovery to verified impact.
home.step1Body: Browse planting campaigns near you, or plant on your own.
home.step2Body: Register for a campaign, or plant a tree individually with no campaign at all.
home.step3Body: Record the species, date, approximate location and a photo when you can.
home.step4Body: Every submission is reviewed before it counts toward official figures.
home.step5Body: Track your own contribution and the community's across every wilaya.
home.recentTreesSubtitle: Submissions confirmed by the review team.
home.wilayasSubtitle: Wilayas with verified trees on record.
home.ctaTitle: One tree is enough to start
home.ctaBody: Create your account and record your first tree today. No need to wait for a campaign.
